semantic.justification: Stores complete ODT package bytes as the only browser document body; old JSON records are not read or migrated. This browser policy is an intentional upstream divergence and must not be rewritten by parity work. TaskFJTKAS extracts the existing Writer complete-package IndexedDB store,title uniqueness and autosave cadence into format-neutral framework/browser owners. Writer adapters retain the database vite-office-writer-workbench and10second interval,1second idle,30second maximum delay,input/capture handling,primary byte storage and no recovery copies. The shared scheduler receives suite-owned dirty/content,save,failure and subscription callbacks;it owns no document model. Calc uses the same storage transactions and timing policy with a separate suite database. This is an intentional browser persistence adaptation,not native AutoRecovery parity.
